definitions.explanation: Abbreviated form of スノーボード.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}はスノボに{行|い}きたい。
examples.english: I want to go snowboarding in winter.

examples.japanese: スノボを{始|はじ}めたばかりで、まだ{初心者|しょしんしゃ}だ。
examples.english: I just started snowboarding and I'm still a beginner.

examples.japanese: スノボとスキー、どっちが{好|す}き?
examples.english: Which do you like better, snowboarding or skiing?

notes:
スノボ is an abbreviated form of スノーボード (snowboard/snowboarding).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・スノボをする - to go snowboarding
・スノボに{行|い}く - to go snowboarding (travel)
・スノボを{習|なら}う - to learn snowboarding
・スノボ{用品|ようひん} - snowboarding gear

RELATED:
・スキー - skiing
・ゲレンデ - ski slope
・リフト - ski lift
